design_direction: Tactical Precision SaaS — Clean, Deep-Contrast, Editorial-Engineering Hybrid
archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast meets The Performance Pro (Dark Navy & Crisp White/Blue)
overview: NexusOS enhancement blueprint to eliminate visual artifacts (duplicate ghost numbers, flat gray cards, visual monotony) and elevate the app to a top-tier SME executive cockpit without altering existing business logic, routing, or state stores.

ghost_numbers_bug.problem: User reported 'you can see numbers behind the actual numbers in the preview'.
root_causes: In KpiCard or table cells, opacity or backdrop-filter overlays, duplicate render passes, or decorative watermark counters bleed through.
Card background transparency (e.g., bg-card/90 or bg-background/90 without solid backing) layered over text or duplicate DOM children.
Tabular font rendering where fallback fonts render before web font swaps without font-display: optional or layout shift.
Recharts tooltip overlapping container values or SVG duplicate ghost paths during responsive resize.

Fix: Ensure solid surfaces on KPI cards ('bg-card' with explicit border rather than semi-transparent layering over content), isolate font-mono tabular-nums in crisp, opaque containers, ensure single value render tree with explicit leading-none and no pseudo-element shadow-clones.

headings.usage: Page titles, section headers, dialog titles, tab triggers
headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Always apply tracking-tight or tracking-tighter on text-xl and larger.

body.family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
body.usage: Subtitles, metadata, table rows, form labels, descriptions
body.rules: Comfortable line height leading-relaxed for body, leading-normal for form inputs.

numbers_and_data.usage: Currencies, KPI numbers, invoice codes, stat chips, timestamps
numbers_and_data.rules: Always pair with tabular-nums. Maintain strict character alignment. Never blur or apply pseudo-drop-shadows that cause duplicate number ghosts.

hierarchy_scale.h1_page_header: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-heading font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground
hierarchy_scale.h2_section_header: text-lg sm:text-xl font-heading font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground
hierarchy_scale.kpi_metric_primary: font-mono text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-[32px] font-bold tracking-tight tabular-nums text-foreground leading-none
hierarchy_scale.kpi_metric_secondary: font-mono text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums text-foreground leading-tight

color_palette_system.theme_mode: System default with light/dark toggle (Light = Crisp Ice White/Blue; Dark = Deep Obsidian/Navy)

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing meets Information Density. Dashboards should breathe at the page and section level, yet stay razor-sharp and dense inside data widgets.

outer_container.padding_comfortable: px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 sm:py-8 space-y-8
outer_container.padding_compact: px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-4 sm:py-5 space-y-5

grid_archetypes.kpi_strip: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-5
grid_archetypes.glance_chips_grid: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3 sm:gap-4

kpi_card.redesign_concept: Dual-layer micro-architectural card with top accent beacon, high-precision JetBrains Mono metric, and pill delta chip.
critical_fixes: Eliminate semi-transparent bleed by replacing 'bg-card/90' with solid 'bg-card shadow-sm'.
Remove any stacked text or double-rendered shadows that caused numbers behind numbers.
Add subtle 1px border with hover glow (border-border hover:border-primary/40 transition-colors).
Top micro-accent line or icon-badge with tactile contrast.

tailwind_classes.card_wrapper: relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-md hover:border-border/80 group
tailwind_classes.label: text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-muted-foreground
tailwind_classes.icon_badge: flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:scale-105
tailwind_classes.metric_value: mt-4 font-mono text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground tabular-nums select-all leading-none
tailwind_classes.delta_pill: inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums border

principles: DO NOT animate chart wrappers using CSS transforms or framer-motion transforms: Recharts measures DOM node width via getBoundingClientRect, and scaling transforms trigger measurement glitches and duplicate rendering.
Chart Card headers must feature a distinct title, clean time-range chip or subtitle, and a compact legend.
Custom Tooltip styling: Opaque card background with rounded-lg border border-border, shadow-lg, and crisp monospace values.
Cartesian grid lines: stroke='hsl(var(--border))' strokeDasharray='3 3' opacity={0.6}.

header_and_navigation.redesign_concept: Tactical Control Deck — solid glassmorphism, crisp border-b, tactile buttons, and high-visibility notification counters.
rules: NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds. Use 'bg-background/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border'.
Quick Create Button: Primary solid accent with tactile shadow ('shadow-sm hover:shadow-primary/25').
Theme & Density Toggles: Clean pill-like hover states with high-contrast active icons.
User Avatar: 1px luminous border with custom status ring.

sidebar.redesign_concept: Obsidian Anchor Rail — clear visual hierarchy between operational sections (Home, Business Ops, Organization), high-contrast active indicators.
sidebar.active_state_classes: bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold border-r-2 border-primary rounded-l-lg rounded-r-none
sidebar.section_header_classes: px-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-muted-foreground/70 mb-2 mt-4

workspace_tabs.redesign_concept: Browser-Style Engineered Tab Strip — clean pill tabs, smooth scroll, clear active marker, quick close interaction.
workspace_tabs.container: flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto border-b border-border bg-card/60 px-3 py-2 scrollbar-none

stat_chips.redesign_concept: Executive Stat Badges — compact cards with icon squircle, uppercase label, and bold JetBrains Mono counters.
stat_chips.classes: flex items-center gap-3.5 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-3.5 text-left transition-all duration-200 hover:border-primary/50 hover:bg-muted/30 hover:shadow-sm group

enhancements: Card view: 3-column responsive grid with crisp divider, uppercase field titles in tracking-wider muted font, and highlighted primary identifier.
Table view: Crisp border, hover rows with subtle left primary indicator or tinted bg-muted/40.
Compact density mode support: data-density='compact' row padding py-2.5 vs comfortable py-4.

ai_insights_card.redesign_concept: Subtle Violet-Tinted Copilot Surface — structured insight tiles with micro-action indicators.
ai_insights_card.classes: relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-violet-500/20 bg-gradient-to-b from-violet-500/5 via-card to-card p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm

depth_layers: Layer 0 (App Canvas): bg-background with subtle noise / structural contrast
Layer 1 (Cards & Side Rails): bg-card with 1px border-border and soft shadow-xs
Layer 2 (Floating Popovers, Menus, Modals): bg-popover with border-border and shadow-xl
Layer 3 (Toasts & Notifications): sonner toasts with high-contrast accents
visual_enhancers.subtle_tactile_borders: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)) with light-mode 89% luminance and dark-mode 19% luminance for razor-sharp boundaries
visual_enhancers.number_formatting_clarity: All financial numbers use currency context + formatCurrency helper with tabular-nums font-mono so digits don't jump or overlap during updates

strictly_forbidden: Do NOT wrap Recharts ResponsiveContainer in framer-motion components that apply scale(), translateY(), or matrix3d() transforms.
Do NOT apply 'transition: all' globally on tables or chart wrappers.
approved_animations: Page fade in: opacity from 0 to 1 with 0.25s ease-out
Micro-interactions on buttons/cards: transform scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] with transition-transform duration-150
Tab transitions: smooth border-color and background-color transitions (duration-150)

accessibility_and_testability.wcag_standards: Contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for normal text, >= 3:1 for large display headers and icons

step_by_step_implementation_plan.step_1: Audit and harden index.css: enforce solid background variables, refine scrollbars, remove duplicate text-shadow/ghost artifact causes, and configure clean tabular-nums styles.
step_by_step_implementation_plan.step_2: Upgrade KpiCard.js: eliminate opacity stacking, apply solid bg-card with precision border, elevate JetBrains Mono metric hierarchy, and polish delta pill styling.
step_by_step_implementation_plan.step_3: Polish Dashboard.js: align 12-column bento rhythm in Overview, Finance, and Operations tabs; inject refined chart tooltips and clean empty-state visuals; update StatChips to tactile buttons.
step_by_step_implementation_plan.step_4: Refine Header.js and WorkspaceTabs.js: enhance contrast, verify z-index and backdrop-filter clarity, and ensure density and theme toggles deliver immediate tactile feedback.
step_by_step_implementation_plan.step_5: Elevate DataTable.js and ResourceManager.js: sharpen table headers, refine hover states and density modes, and polish card-grid view for responsive screens.
step_by_step_implementation_plan.step_6: Verify and validate: run unit and automated tests, verify test IDs remain intact, and verify no visual ghosting or layout breaks occur across light and dark modes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never generate AI slop: avoid generic rounded pill-heavy SaaS clones with washed-out gray text.
Ensure every number has tabular-nums and strict mono alignment without duplicate text overlays.
Always preserve all existing features: collapsible sidebar, density toggle, currency switcher, theme switch, tabs bar, and all test IDs.
Keep files in JavaScript (.js and .jsx), not TypeScript (.tsx), matching the project codebase.
All interactive elements must retain or include explicit data-testid attributes for testing.
